zh.what: 后台任务完成提示会跨主机重启和升级保留。主会话空闲时补送，确认收到后才结清。
zh.action: 本条未提供操作步骤，请核实是否需要设置。

en.what: Background completion notices survive a host restart or update. Agent J delivers them when your main session is idle and keeps them until receipt is confirmed.
en.action: No action steps were supplied for this change; check whether setup is needed.

zh.what: 切换 AI 工具、压缩对话、紧急修复或升级后，Agent J 会继续已确认尚未提交的任务，并在原回执上更新状态。已经开始但结果未知的任务会留待核对。
zh.action: 本条未提供操作步骤，请核实是否需要设置。

en.what: After you switch AI tools, compact a conversation, repair the host, or update, Agent J resumes tasks it can verify were still waiting and updates the original receipt. Started tasks with an unknown outcome stay pending review.
en.action: No action steps were supplied for this change; check whether setup is needed.

zh.what: 经 Agent J 上传 YouTube 视频时，每次上传都会在已配对遥控器显示文件、标题和可见性，并等待批准。如果上传回执丢失，Agent J 会先核对原上传状态。
zh.action: 本条未提供操作步骤，请核实是否需要设置。

en.what: Every YouTube upload through Agent J shows the file, title, and visibility on a paired remote and waits for approval. If the upload receipt is lost, Agent J checks the original upload status first.
en.action: No action steps were supplied for this change; check whether setup is needed.

zh.what: 主机体检分别报告主 Agent 核心文件完整性问题和工作目录配置问题。窄屏上的 sudo 和升级审批卡也更容易操作。
